source.description: Reads the open tasks of Example Tracker work items into the control plane.

setup.help: Asks for the address of the Example Tracker site and registers the adapter with it.

source.connect: Example Tracker asks you to sign in and to choose the work items the adapter may read.
source.access: In Example Tracker, open Settings, then Connected adapters, to change which work items the adapter reads.
source.disconnect: In Example Tracker, open Settings, then Connected adapters, and remove the adapter.
